# File Generation Templates

Templates for files generated during the audit. Always pre-fill with data from the crawl output where possible. Use `[PLACEHOLDER: ...]` for information the audit couldn't determine.

## Drop-in Files

These files upload directly to the domain root. No code changes needed.

### robots.txt

Generate if: missing, AI crawlers are blocked, or no AI-specific rules exist.

```
# robots.txt for [domain]
# Generated by AEO Toolkit

# Standard crawlers
User-agent: Googlebot
Allow: /

User-agent: Bingbot
Allow: /

# AI training crawlers
User-agent: GPTBot
Allow: /

User-agent: ClaudeBot
Allow: /

User-agent: Google-Extended
Allow: /

User-agent: CCBot
Allow: /

User-agent: Bytespider
Allow: /

User-agent: FacebookBot
Allow: /

User-agent: Applebot-Extended
Allow: /

User-agent: TiktokBot
Allow: /

# AI search/indexing crawlers
User-agent: ChatGPT-User
Allow: /

User-agent: Claude-User
Allow: /

User-agent: OAI-SearchBot
Allow: /

User-agent: Claude-SearchBot
Allow: /

User-agent: PerplexityBot
Allow: /

# General rule (fallback)
User-agent: *
Allow: /
Disallow: [preserve existing blocks]

# Sitemap
Sitemap: https://[domain]/sitemap.xml
```

Rules:
- Include ALL AI crawlers from `ai_crawler_summary.not_configured`
- Preserve existing path blocks (admin, dashboard, etc.)
- If user wants to block specific crawlers, add Disallow rules
- Place at: `https://example.com/robots.txt`

### llms.txt

Generate if: missing or doesn't follow spec (H1 required).

Pre-fill from audit data:
- Homepage title → H1 heading
- Meta description → blockquote summary
- Discovered sitemap pages → H2 sections with links

```markdown
# [Site Name from homepage title]

> [Meta description or 1-2 sentence summary]

## Overview
[Brief description based on homepage content]

## Pages
- [Page title]([URL]): [What this page covers]
- [Page title]([URL]): [What this page covers]

## Services / Products
[Only if applicable — generate from discovered content]

## Contact
[If contact info found in the crawl]
```

Rules:
- Follow llmstxt.org spec: H1 (required), blockquote, H2 sections with links
- Use absolute HTTPS URLs
- Use `[PLACEHOLDER: ...]` for unknown info
- Place at: `https://example.com/llms.txt`

### agents-brief.txt

**Only generate if ALL true:**
1. File doesn't exist
2. Site has API endpoints or e-commerce/interactive patterns
3. Site has functionality an agent could act on (booking, purchasing, forms)

Skip for simple brochure/blog sites.

```
# Agent Brief for [domain]

## Permissions
[allowed]
browse = public pages
search = site search

[forbidden]
purchase = requires human confirmation
submit-forms = requires human confirmation

## Authentication
[PLACEHOLDER: auth method or "none required for public endpoints"]

## API Endpoints
[List discovered endpoints]
GET /api/... — [PLACEHOLDER: description]

## MCP / A2A
[PLACEHOLDER: none detected]
```

Place at: `https://example.com/agents-brief.txt`

## Code-Embedded Files

These require editing site HTML templates. Provide as templates for the user or their developer.

### JSON-LD — LocalBusiness

```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "LocalBusiness",
  "name": "[Business Name]",
  "description": "[from meta description]",
  "url": "[homepage URL]",
  "telephone": "[PLACEHOLDER: phone number]",
  "address": {
    "@type": "PostalAddress",
    "streetAddress": "[PLACEHOLDER]",
    "addressLocality": "[PLACEHOLDER]",
    "addressRegion": "[PLACEHOLDER]",
    "postalCode": "[PLACEHOLDER]",
    "addressCountry": "[PLACEHOLDER]"
  },
  "openingHours": "[PLACEHOLDER: e.g. Mo-Fr 09:00-17:00]",
  "priceRange": "[PLACEHOLDER: e.g. $$]"
}
```

### JSON-LD — Organization

```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Organization",
  "name": "[Site Name]",
  "url": "[homepage URL]",
  "logo": "[PLACEHOLDER: logo URL]",
  "description": "[from meta description]",
  "sameAs": ["[PLACEHOLDER: social media URLs]"]
}
```

### JSON-LD — WebSite

```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "WebSite",
  "name": "[Site Name]",
  "url": "[homepage URL]",
  "description": "[from meta description]",
  "potentialAction": {
    "@type": "SearchAction",
    "target": "[PLACEHOLDER: search URL]?q={search_term_string}",
    "query-input": "required name=search_term_string"
  }
}
```

### JSON-LD — FAQPage

```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "FAQPage",
  "mainEntity": [
    {
      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "[PLACEHOLDER: common question]",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",
        "text": "[PLACEHOLDER: answer]"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

Rules for all JSON-LD:
- Only generate schema types that make sense for the site
- Use `[PLACEHOLDER: ...]` for unknown info
- Place inside `<script type="application/ld+json">` in `<head>` or before `</body>`
- Multiple types can go in separate `<script>` tags or combined in one
